Facebook post showing a downed tree across Fritz Cove Road after dock street.
Gustavus DOT called and reported multiple trees down on main and side roads. A tree fell on someones car.

PAJN gusted to 55 kts (63 MPH) at 11:53 AM on 10/20/26.
Received a call from the SOC who got a call from Pelican reporting trees down and potentially damaged houses.

Report from Facebook for shingles blowing off a roof near the Governors mansion.

Report of trees fallen behind Aarons house.
FB Video of tree falling across Cohen Drive.
